metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to fix ankle pain (and sprain) at home, using NO EQUIPMENT!

This EASY, effective three part guide will focus on quick ankle sprain and pain relief, improving range of motion, and helping to prevent pain and strain by strengthening the foot and ankle.

All three parts target the ankle in a different way, but when put together, you'll get the best results. Make sure to go through all three, and take what works best for you. 

As a bonus, all of these ankle sprain and pain stretching exercises can be done at home, don't require and special equipment, and make give fast relief... even in as little as 30 SECONDS!

WATCH now and quickly get rid of ankle pain at home!
